No, that's not covered. According to our policy, **yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress** and isn't covered under the Plant Care Guarantee on its own.

If your plant shows **significant decline** (losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse), then you can file a claim. Otherwise, this is expected after delivery—just continue with regular care. Need help with watering or anything else? Happy to assist!
